package.name: kin5axcam
package.description: A 3D Surface (5axis) operation for the CAM workbench: a zigzag over the parameter space of one face, cut with a ball nose tool. The path carries the centre of the ball, which is the programmed point of a cutter location file, so it feeds the kin5ax five-axis postprocessor directly. The orientation of the tool follows in the next versions.

workbench.description: Adds the command CAM_Surface5Axis to the CAM workbench. It is not a workbench of its own.
